title: ev.io
description: Futuristic 3D FPS arena shooter! Master double jumps, teleportation abilities, grenade throws, and railgun sniper shots in high-speed sci-fi multiplayer combat.
author: Addicting Games / ev.io

title: Geometry Dash Lite
description: Jump, fly, and flip your way through dangerous geometric passages and spiky obstacles in this legendary rhythm-based platformer!
author: RobTop Games

title: Subway Surfers
description: Dash as fast as you can through subway tracks! Dodge oncoming trains, leap over barriers, and hoverboard through obstacles.
author: SYBO Games

title: 1v1.LOL RELOADED
description: The ultimate 3D building and shooting simulator! Fight in 1v1 duels, build defensive ramps and walls, and eliminate rivals in 1v1.LOL RELOADED.
controls: Z, X, C, V Building Keys
author: JustPlay.LOL

title: Drive Mad
description: Drive a monster truck over crazy physics-based obstacle tracks! Balance speed and control to cross the finish line without flipping.
author: Martin Magni / Fancade

title: Stickman Hook
description: Swing like Spider-Man as a bouncy stickman! Grapple onto pegs, execute incredible acrobatic flips, and soar across the finish line.
author: Madbox

title: Vex 7
description: The peak of hardcore stickman parkour! Master deadly spikes, laser beams, falling platforms, and wall jumps across dangerous acts.
author: Amazing Adam

title: Basket Random
description: Wacky ragdoll 2-player basketball with random physics, changing courts, and unpredictable players! Score 5 points to win.
author: RHM Interactive

title: Soccer Random
description: Hilarious single button ragdoll soccer! Play on snowy fields, sandy beaches, or muddy grounds with random weather and balls.
author: RHM Interactive

title: Half-Life 2
description: Play Half-Life 2 directly in your browser! Experience Gordon Freeman's iconic sci-fi FPS journey through City 17 with realistic physics, gravity gun mechanics, and thrilling combat.
controls: Space Jump, Shift Sprint, C Crouch
author: Valve / Slqnt

title: Half-Life 1
description: Play the original 1998 GoldSrc FPS classic in your browser! Survive the Black Mesa research facility incident as Dr. Gordon Freeman.
author: Valve / Slqnt

title: Retro Bowl
description: The ultimate 8-bit American football management game! Call plays, pass, run, and manage your team to Super Bowl glory.
author: New Star Games

title: Tunnel Rush
description: Blaze through a 3D neon tunnel at lightning speed! Dodge rotating hazard barriers, test your reflexes, and beat high scores.
controls: A / D or Arrow Keys Rotate Tunnel
author: Deer Cat Games

title: Rooftop Run
description: High-octane 3D parkour runner across city skyscrapers! Sprint, jump, slide, and perform acrobatic flips across rooftop ledges.
controls: WASD or Arrow Keys to Move & Steer
Shift or Down Arrow to Slide
author: Arcade Studio

title: Smash Karts
description: 3D multiplayer kart battle arena game! Drive karts, pick up weapons, and blow up other players to win the round.
controls: WASD or Arrow Keys to Drive
Drive over mystery boxes to collect weapons
author: Tall Team

title: Color Puzzles
description: Shift color frequencies to pass through matching energy barriers, activate light bridges, and solve 6 mind-bending puzzle chambers.
controls: 1, 2, 3 or C / Shift to Switch Color
author: Chroma Labs Studio

title: The Chroma Incident
description: Navigate through colored laser grids and energy fields in this official Chroma Incident puzzle game.
controls: WASD or Arrow Keys to move
author: GamePix

title: 2048 Frost Edition
description: Slide matching ice tiles together to reach the legendary 2048 tile! Smooth, addictive puzzle action with cold frost aesthetics.
controls: Use Arrow Keys or WASD to slide tiles
Combine identical numbers to double them
author: Gabriele Cirulli

title: Slope
description: Drive a ball down a steep neon 3D obstacle course at breakneck speeds. Dodge red blocks, jump ramps, and set new high scores!
controls: A / D or Left / Right Arrows to steer
Keep ball on track and avoid obstacles
author: Y8 Games

title: Flappy Bird
description: Guide the bird through dangerous pipe gaps. Simple one-button controls, high difficulty, endless fun!
controls: Tap Space or Click Mouse to flap wings
Don't crash into the ground or pipes
author: Dong Nguyen

title: Icy Snake Classic
description: Eat frosty apples, grow longer, and don't hit your own tail or the ice walls. Classic retro gameplay reinvented.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to navigate
Eat glowing ice apples to gain points
author: Retro Arcade

title: Tetris Ice Blocks
description: Clear full horizontal lines by rotating falling polyomino ice blocks. Fast-paced spatial puzzle action.
controls: Left / Right Arrows to move block
author: Alexey Pajitnov

title: Cookie Clicker Unblocked
description: Click the giant cookie to bake cookies! Upgrade grandmas, factories, and cosmic portals to produce billions of cookies per second.
controls: Left Click on Big Cookie to earn cookies
Buy auto-clickers & multipliers on right panel
author: Orteil

title: Pac-Man Arcade
description: Navigate the maze, eat all yellow dots, and avoid Blinky, Pinky, Inky, and Clyde! Grab power pellets to eat ghosts.
controls: Eat Power Pellets to turn ghosts blue
author: Bandai Namco

title: Paper.io 3D
description: Conquer as much 3D territory as possible! Draw loops around 3D surfaces and rival territory, but don't let anyone bite your tail.
controls: Mouse pointer or WASD to guide block
Form enclosed loops to capture 3D space
Guard your line while outside your territory
author: Voodoo

title: Space Invaders Frost
description: Defend Earth from invading alien armadas! Move your laser cannon behind bunker shields and blast all incoming invaders.
controls: Left / Right Arrow Keys to slide cannon
author: Taito

title: Drift Boss
description: Drift through tricky zigzag roads with endless twists and sharp turns! Timing is everything to avoid falling into the void.
controls: Click or Spacebar to turn Right
Time your drift on narrow icy bridges
author: MarketJS

title: Geometry Dash Lite
description: Jump, fly, and flip your way through dangerous spiky obstacles synced to rhythm-heavy electronic soundtracks!
controls: Click or Spacebar / Up Arrow to jump
author: RobTop Games

title: Moto X3M Bike Race
description: Stunt motorcycle racing game with 25+ challenging levels! Perform backflips, dodge dynamite, and beat the clock.
controls: Left / Right Arrows to lean bike
author: Madpuffers
